device_serial.description: Serial number of the specific sd-mux device to address.

vendor_id.description: Hexadecimal Vendor ID for device discovery. Default 0x04e8 (Samsung).

product_id.description: Hexadecimal Product ID for device discovery. Default 0x6001.

tick_time_ms.description: Time in milliseconds for --tick command power cycle delay.

pins_value.description: Hexadecimal 8-bit word to set FT245RL pins D0-D7.

invert_pins.description: Whether to invert the pins_value before writing to FTDI chip.

list_devices.description: If true, execute --list command to find connected devices.

show_info.description: If true, execute --info command for detailed device info.

show_status.description: If true, execute --status command to check connection state.

set_serial.description: If true, execute --set-serial command with device_serial.

init_device.description: If true, execute --init command to reset device state.

connect_dut.description: If true, execute --dut command to connect to Device Under Test.

connect_ts.description: If true, execute --ts command to connect to Test Server.

tick.description: If true, execute --tick command to power cycle DUT.
